meta.title: Al Muttaqin Cultural Center | Mosque in Matsudo, Chiba
meta.description: A mosque and Islamic cultural center in Matsudo, Chiba: today's prayer times, Jumuah, study circles in three languages, programs for new Muslims and children, infaq, and help for newcomers to Japan.

hero.title: A mosque and learning home in Matsudo, Chiba.
hero.description: Pray together, learn in Japanese, English, and Indonesian, and find your community. Everyone is welcome, whether you have lived here for years or arrived last week.
